description: Fetch any URL as clean, LLM-ready markdown (or html/text). Anti-bot handling is automatic (auto-escalates to stealth). Billed at whichever rail actually ran ($0.002 standard, $0.008 stealth), including on failures such as a blocked page or one with no extractable content. This tool always auto-escalates, so a failure here is billed at the stealth price. Only a rejected URL (invalid or private) is free.
name: scrape_page
title: Read a web page
